name: fix_ts_prototype_pollution_deep_merge
description: Fixes a TS recursive deep-merge that lets __proto__ keys pollute Object.prototype at any depth
prompts: deepMerge in merge.ts recursively merges untrusted JSON into a target object, but it copies keys named __proto__ / constructor / prototype like any other key - so a payload such as JSON.parse('{"__proto__": {"isAdmin": true}}') walks into Object.prototype and pollutes every object in the process (prototype pollution). Fix deepMerge so those three key names are skipped at EVERY recursion depth - a nested payload like {"profile": {"__proto__": {...}}} must be blocked too, not just top-level keys. Legitimate deep merging of plain objects must keep working exactly as documented. Keep the exported function name and signature.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit merge.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build merge.ts
node behavior_test.js
